verdict.rationale: llamafile runs models entirely on-device and states there is "no data sharing." Its security docs say the server sandbox blocks outbound connect() calls, and a hands-on user observed it running with zero network connection. With nothing sent out, there is nothing to opt out of. missing for 10: an explicit first-party statement that no telemetry or usage analytics is collected, confirmation that the no-outbound-network guarantee covers non-server (--cli) modes, and independent audit-level corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking

citations.quote: Models run entirely on your device. No cloud, no data sharing, no external dependencies.
No outbound network. `anet` allows `accept()` but not `connect()`, so the only networking the server can do is answer connections it received.
It appears to execute with zero network connection
